text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... It's really not that easy, huh.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Hishiama-chan and Laurel-chan! What's 
going on, are you cooking something?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, actually, we're challenging 
ourselves to make a full-course French 
meal♪

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~?! A full course?! Whoa, that sounds 
super authentic!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wanted to hone my skills, you know. 
Thought I'd try a different genre than 
usual... but man.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It really is difficult. Even for me, I can 
only manage simple French home cooking.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Appetizer, soup, main dish, and dessert. 
Every single one requires delicate skills. 
It's tough as heck...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But since we started, I'm gonna see it 
through! Giving up halfway would 
completely ruin my rep as an empress!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! I don't want to 
surrender either. Let's do our best 
together, Hishiama-chan!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~...! Amazing, that's so admirable! You 
two are seriously big!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're laying the praise on thick. 
We haven't even finished yet!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
No way, it's not an exaggeration! Not 
giving up even when you fail, that 
fighting spirit— it's the absolute 
coolest!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
I know, Big-san will help out too! Because 
I really want your challenge to succeed!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Roast the beef in the oven, and... Right, 
gotta get the sorbet going in the 
meantime. Hope 15 minutes is enough...

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Leave that to Big-san! All right, I guess 
I'll peel the tomatoes!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
That roast beef just now looked amazing 
too! I bet this'll turn into a wonderful 
course meal~♪

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Thirty, thirty-one... Laurel-chan, it 
might be ready soon!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right! ...Fufu, thanks for 
timing it. The escargot baked beautifully♪

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Something like this is a piece of cake! 
They'll get tough if you cook 'em too 
long, after all.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Now only the main dish is left...! 
Let's keep up the spirit until the very 
end, yeah~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Big-chan is so pumped up... We definitely 
have to see this through, Hishiama-chan!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! After all the help she's given us, 
we can't afford to look pathetic!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Hooray~! Congratulations, you two!

After school, a lively voice echoed from 
the cafeteria. Turning around to look...

There stood roast beef, blancmange... a 
gorgeous spread of dishes lined up across 
the table!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! To actually pull off such a 
challenge! You two are so, so big~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thanks a bunch! We messed up plenty 
of times, but... turned out pretty good, 
don't ya think?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Say, Big-chan. If you'd like, would you 
eat these dishes for us?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Eh, are you sure?! You two worked so hard 
making them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly why! It's thanks to your 
cheering that we were able to give it our 
all to the finish!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, we grew a whole size 
bigger ourselves! Don't hold back, dig 
right in!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Okay, I won't hesitate then! 
Ehehe, thanks for the food~♪
